title: Delta file (edited in this delta) still states the workspace-tests dev-dependencies as sc-agent-types, sc-jev-check, sc-jev-host, serde_json
description: Delta file (edited in this delta) still states the workspace-tests dev-dependencies as sc-agent-types, sc-jev-check, sc-jev-host, serde_json and tempfile. The amended ADR-SAG-0028 (r-7 'Dev-only edges' bullet, docs/architecture.md:1580-1584) and crates/workspace-tests/Cargo.toml:24 add sc-decision-schema (features = ["test-util"]). The crate's own documentation therefore contradicts the amended ADR's dev-only edge set.
